h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Siliguri

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Siliguri

items.pText: From Siliguri, a school in the plains and a resort in the Darjeeling hills can both be reached within a few hours, yet they need quite different playgrounds. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to buyers on both sides of that line: schools, housing complexes and parks in the city, and hotels and campuses up in the hills. We make it at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,780 km away.

Siliguri is the main road and rail gateway to the Northeast, Sikkim and the Darjeeling hills. The plains around it are hot and very wet in the monsoon, while the hills are cool, misty and steep. Tell us where your site is, how big it is and who will use it, and send a few photos. We will suggest equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Plains sites and hill sites around Siliguri

c: On the plains, the main concerns are heat, humidity and standing water after heavy rain. Raise the play area slightly, slope it towards a drain and lay rubber flooring on top. Shade over slides helps from April to June.

In the hills, flat ground is the challenge. Plan a levelled terrace with a drain on the uphill side, and grout posts into firm ground rather than loose fill. Mist and damp encourage moss on shaded decks, so scrub them now and then. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit both settings. For Sikkim, see our

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in the Darjeeling hills?
items.a: Yes, once a level area is ready. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Share photos of the slope and the road access first.

items.q: What surface works on the plains around Siliguri?
items.a: Rubber flooring on a slightly raised, well-drained base. It dries quickly after heavy rain and cushions falls better than soil or grass.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment in Siliguri too?
items.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range suits parks, societies and campuses. See our outdoor gym page for Siliguri, or ask us to add a fitness corner to your layout.
